# KidEase

KidEase (https://www.kidease.ca) helps parents in Canada find a licensed daycare, compare centres, and ask for a tour. Daycare owners can claim their listing and reply to parents.

Fees, ages, and open spots are shown only when that centre or a public registry published them.

## Key pages

- Home: https://www.kidease.ca/
- Search: https://www.kidease.ca/search
- French home: https://www.kidease.ca/fr
- French search: https://www.kidease.ca/fr/search
- Cities: https://www.kidease.ca/cities
- Benefits: https://www.kidease.ca/benefits
- FAQ: https://www.kidease.ca/faq
- Help: https://www.kidease.ca/help
- Claim a listing: https://www.kidease.ca/claim
- Contact: https://www.kidease.ca/contact
